title: API Gateway
subtitle: One front door turns eight phone calls into one, and becomes a single point of failure
motto: Put the cross-cutting work at one door, and then keep the door open
keyInsight: A gateway cuts round trips, repeated auth and client coupling, but every request now depends on it, so it must be replicated.

decisions.title: Compose inside the data centre
decisions.description: The gateway fans out where a round trip costs 2 ms, so the slow phone link is paid once instead of once per service.
decisions.alternatives: Letting the phone call each service keeps the gateway thin, but pays the phone round trip and an auth check eight times.

decisions.title: Count the gateway in availability
decisions.description: The failure frame adds the gateway's own downtime and blast radius, because a component every request passes through can take everything down.
decisions.alternatives: Showing only the latency win would hide that the door is now the one thing that must never fail.
